# PCS LLC

PCS LLC is the confirmed company name associated with Tyler Palmer's work trucks. Tyler is a mechanic in the Rockford, Illinois area and publicly offers bucket trucks.

This design review positions the website around bucket trucks, service trucks, crane trucks and related commercial work-truck equipment. Exact inventory and service claims must be approved by Tyler before final launch.

Primary public contact in this demo: https://www.facebook.com/tyler.palmer.562/

Do not infer a public street address, phone number, dealer status, financing, inspections, certifications, warranties or equipment specifications from this demo.
